tools.name: istanbul_search_datasets
tools.description: Search the IBB open data catalog.

tools.name: istanbul_get_dataset
tools.description: Return metadata and resources for one IBB dataset.

tools.name: istanbul_get_resource_schema
tools.description: Return DataStore field schema for a resource.

tools.name: istanbul_query_resource
tools.description:
Query IBB CKAN DataStore records with guarded filters and limits.

    API reference: https://docs.ckan.org/en/latest/maintaining/datastore.html
    Uses datastore_search, not SQL; field names come from the resource schema.

tools.name: istanbul_nearby
tools.description:
Find city services by kind and coordinates, or parking/pharmacy by district.

    bbox and types apply only to city_feature (parking, metro_station,
    air_quality_station, public_transport_stop, wifi, ev_charging, taxi_stand,
    market). air_quality includes latest readings; city_feature has stat

tools.name: istanbul_water_status
tools.description:
Get ISKI active faults (district or fault_number) or dam occupancy.

    Dam filters apply only to dams; fault_number is exclusive with district.
    Nearby faults are provided by istanbul_nearby(kind="water_fault"). Results
    carry fallback freshness and approximate fault locations; no restoratio

tools.name: istanbul_mobility_nearby
tools.description:
Summarize mobility near a static place reference or coordinates.

    district (all 39 Istanbul districts) is exclusive with place/coordinates and
    returns parking only, without distances. District-only place names do the same.
    For Acıbadem specify 'Acıbadem, Kadıköy' or 'Acıbadem, Üsküdar'.

tools.name: istanbul_city_services_nearby
tools.description:
Summarize WiFi near a static reference point and district-level libraries/culture.

    district (all 39 Istanbul districts) is exclusive with place/coordinates;
    district-only place names also return district address lists, without WiFi or
    invented distances. Radius applies only to WiFi with

tools.name: istanbul_neighborhood_profile
tools.description: Return a joined neighborhood profile from social, building, and earthquake scenario records.

tools.name: istanbul_transit_line
tools.description:
Get IETT line info, ordered stops or planned main-terminal departures.

    limit applies only to departures. This is not live intermediate-stop ETA.
    Cross-operator service notices are provided by istanbul_transport_disruptions.

tools.name: istanbul_transport_disruptions
tools.description: Return current official disruptions and service announcements across supported transport operators.

tools.name: istanbul_metro_accessibility_status
tools.description: Return official Metro İstanbul equipment/total counts and current equipment fault details, optionally filtered by line, station, or equipment type. This is not an end-to-end accessibility guarantee.

tools.name: istanbul_datastore_query
tools.description:

    aggregates are supported; no writes, arbitrary functions or application DB.

tools.name: istanbul_market_schedule
tools.description:
Return the published weekly İBB market schedule, optionally by district/day.

    day accepts Turkish/English weekdays, today/yesterday/tomorrow, or an ISO
    date. Results are a static weekly schedule, not proof a market is open today;
    coordinates are source points and maps_url is a map search
